env.title: Environment variables
env.rowHelp: Its programs read them when they start. Values are never shown again once saved.
env.lede: Saved values are not shown here.
env.readFailed: The variables of {{name}} could not be read.
env.syncing: The last change has not reached the computer yet.
env.add.title: New variables
env.add.help: Values are masked as you type.
env.err.listed: {{name}} is already set. Give it a new value in the list above.
env.rep.notSent: Not sent: {{names}}. They are still in the form.
env.wait.set: {{name}} may have its new value. The list cannot tell; saving it again does no harm.
env.wait.new: {{name}} may have been saved. Check again reads the list.
env.wait.remove: {{name}} may have been removed. Check again reads the list.
env.why.expired: This computer has expired, so its variables cannot change.
env.why.lostServer: The variables cannot change: the owner no longer has the server this computer is on.
